Long Empty Gaps
May 2026 • Solo
Azabu cares way more about the food than flashy hotel decor. They use freshly grated real wasabi that adds a clean, natural heat. Rich foie gras also matches the chawanmushi surprisingly well. The best dish is the wagyu and sweet corn claypot rice, where the rich beef fat balances the corn’s sweetness beautifully. However, the service really slowed things down. The pacing was uneven, leaving empty 20-minute gaps between later courses. The staff served in silence without any explanations. Even the tableside blowtorch work felt clumsy. The cooking itself is excellent, but the service needs basic training to match it.

Written June 28, 2026
HÔTEL du PARC HANOÏ
Dear Valued Guest,

Thank you very much for taking the time to share your detailed feedback regarding your recent dining experience at AZABU.

We are truly delighted to know that you appreciated the quality of our cuisine, particularly the freshly grated wasabi, foie gras chawanmushi, and our Wagyu & Sweet Corn Claypot Rice. Your thoughtful descriptions of the flavors and balance of the dishes are deeply appreciated by our culinary team, who strive to showcase the finest ingredients and authentic Japanese dining experience.

At the same time, we sincerely apologize that the service did not meet the same standard as the food. We regret the long intervals between courses, the lack of explanations from our team, and the impression created during the tableside presentation. Your comments have been shared with our service team and management as valuable feedback, and we will reinforce our training to ensure better pacing, communication, and overall guest engagement.

At AZABU, we believe that exceptional cuisine should always be accompanied by equally attentive and seamless service. We truly appreciate your honest observations, as they help us improve and deliver a more memorable experience for all our guests.

We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back and provide you with the level of service that fully reflects the quality of our cuisine.

Warm regards,
Guest Relations Team

Absolutely outstanding we dined there 2 nights running one of the tastiest meals I’ve ever had
Nov 2022 • Couples
This was the best food from our trip in Vietnam. Totally 5 star deliciousness top class. Absolutely everything was amazing. The tuna amuse Bouche full of flavour. Shrimp tempura big juicy with crunchy light batter. The crab croquettes and dip oh my the flavours just melted in your mouth. The best cod roe I have ever had my partner said he didn’t like cod roe until I made him taste this yet again just melted in your mouth, I wished I hadn’t encouraged him to try it because he scoffed half. He loved the tender teriyaki beef. The lobster was HUGE and cooked to perfection. Loved the Hanoi craft ales. The sake flights were mmmm particularly loved Dassai 45. The crab with roe on top had such fresh flavours. I think I will dream about this restaurant forever is was absolutely amazing and should be Michelin star. Love mango tarts for dessert so tasty. Dream restaurant if only all food tasted this good.
